suppress.notes:
CVE-2025-15104 is a server side request forgery in Nu Html Checker (validator.nu), a Java service that fetches URLs on behalf of callers. The npm package `validator` is a string validation library by Chris O'Hara: it performs no network access at all, and the two share nothing but the word "validator".
Dependency-Check reached this finding by matching the package name against cpe:2.3:a:validator:validator, which is the CPE of the Java product. The advisory text in the report says so in its first sentence.
Reviewed on 2026-09-04. Confirmed false positive.
